title: Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 描述评分指标或评测协议

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed.
